capabilities.notes: Local filesystem access is available in the active project.
Project and user MCP configuration are supported.
Canonical .claude/skills are loaded by Claude Code.
PreToolUse, prompt-submit, session, and post-tool hooks are available.
SessionStart and SessionEnd surfaces are available.
Dex's OS-scheduled jobs are independent of the chat harness.
AskUserQuestion is available when the client provides it.
The portable Agent Plugins package remains the compatibility floor.

limitations: Claude-only hooks are not copied into harness-neutral adapters.
name: Claude Code
summary: Dex's Tier 3 reference harness with native skills, MCP, hooks, and session lifecycle support.
